title: Omugugu Oguleeta Okuwona
intro: Omwoyo ogwagezesebwa okusukkiridde gwaggyibwako okubudaabudibwa, banne, n’amaanyi g’omubiri. Nga yeeyawudde mu kubonaabona okw’amaanyi, omuddu wa Allah ono yakyuka n’adda eri Obwakatonda yekka. Okuyita mu bugumiikiriza obutasalako n’okusaba okuva ku mutima, omuyaga ogw’okusaasira gwatuuka ogwasukkulumye ku byonna bye baali basuubira. Ani ono ffiga eyeewaayo ye eyaggulawo oluggi lw’okuzzaawo?
clues: Nnali muweereza wa Allah omuganzi, nga nnyumirwa bingi, amaka agakulaakulana, n’obulamu obulungi mu nnaku zange.
Awo okugezesebwa ne kukka: obugagga ne bugenda, abaagalwa ne bagenda, n’omubiri gwange ne gukubwa okubonaabona okw’amaanyi.
Abo abaali okumpi nange tebaasobola kugumiikiriza mbeera yange, era nnasigala nga nneeyawudde ku balala, omubiri gwange nga gunyiize olw’okubonaabona.
Nakoowoola Mukama wange, nga ntegeeza nti Sitaani yankwatako n’obukoowu n’ekibonerezo.
Eky’okuddamu kyajja — ekiragiro okukuba ettaka n’ekigere kyange, era okuva mu yo ne gakulukuta amazzi amayonjo okuwona.
Mukama wange yaggyawo ddala obuzibu n’anzizaayo amaka gange, ne geeyongera obungi, ng’akabonero k’okusaasira eri abo abafumiitiriza.

arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
verse: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding. (38:43)
